newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Compaq up, Sun off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Compaq up, Sun off.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp shares firmed preceding Wednesday's market open after the company reported third quarter earning that far exceeded Wall Street expectations.
The shares rose 3-1/8 to 75 ahead of the opening bell and the Compaq results were expected to energize trading in PC and related stocks, traders said.

Elsewhere, Sun Microsystems Inc share fell to 64-3/4 from 70, a decline traders attributed to an earnings report that exceeded estimates but failed to satisfy investors who bought the stock during a sharp, October run-up.
Traders said the shares soared to 70 from 60 in the past two weeks, primarily on expectations that Sun would deliver a "blowout" fiscal first quarter earnings report.

But when the computer workstation maker reported earnings of $0.61 per share for the three months ended September 29, it was $0.02 above the consensus outlook, a margin too small to support the lofty stock price, traders added.
They also noted that there is some concern Sun cannot sustain the record-high pre-tax operating margin of 9.5 percent posted in the quarter.

As for Compaq's results, the PC maker posted third quarter earnings of $1.25 per share diluted, $0.18 above the First Call consensus analysts' estimate, and beyond the $0.89 per share earned in the year-ago period.
Revenues for the quarter grew to $4.5 billion from $3.6 billion.
